entries.what: Arrives at 7:20 to beat the Vinca drop-off line and sets up B12 with Dana for the first day. Teaches periods 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6, with the lab-pair chart for third period, where Karina and Dulce are partners.
entries.outcome: First day ran smoothly, pair chart posted.

entries.what: Eats leftover rice and ulam in B12 during 4th period prep and runs Eli's extended-time test setup.
entries.outcome: Arranged to run Eli's tests in B12 during prep.

entries.what: Staff meeting where Principal Ocampo explains the new weekly chronic-absence reports. Grace notes the lab budget is $900 for all five sections.
entries.outcome: Knows she must fill the form by hand every Friday.

entries.what: Home at Tamarisk Court, dinner with Nanay and Isabel, then the teleserye with Corazón at 9. Ramón is on shift.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening, short exchange with Isabel about homework.

entries.what: Teaches all five sections; Tuesday is a lab safety day. Dulce and Karina work together in third period, Karina turning in a strong write-up.
entries.outcome: Karina's early lab work is excellent, an A- start.

entries.what: Uses her prep period to plan the Unit 1 measurement labs and counts goggles in B12 with Dana.
entries.outcome: Goggle count is short by six; adds to supply list.

entries.what: Fills up the minivan at the Ruel Road station on the way home and picks up groceries.
entries.outcome: Saved the 30 cents a gallon.

entries.what: Heat wave begins and the school holds a minimum day; B12 is stuffy, so she shifts to a demonstration in the morning classes.
entries.outcome: Classes cut short, labs postponed.

entries.what: Picks up Isabel after school because of the heat, then checks on Corazón, who is resting in the back bedroom.
entries.outcome: Everyone stays inside with fans on.

entries.what: Preps next week's lab handouts at the kitchen table in the evening, then the teleserye with her mother.
entries.outcome: Handouts drafted.

entries.what: Second heat wave day with another minimum schedule; Grace and Dana eat lunch in B12, Dana venting about her principal evaluation.
entries.outcome: Shared a cold lunch with Dana.

entries.what: Runs the Thursday routine and reviews Karina's and Dulce's lab write-ups while heat lingers in B12.
entries.outcome: Marked the first stack of write-ups.

entries.what: Reminds herself of back-to-school night on Sept 4 and lists what to present to parents.
entries.outcome: Started a presentation outline.

entries.what: Fills Principal Ocampo's absence form by hand from the gradebook, her first Friday form of the year, and turns it in on time.
entries.outcome: Submitted, though it took far longer than she wanted.

entries.what: Heat wave continues with a minimum day. Teaches shortened periods and sends students home early.
entries.outcome: Got through all five sections.

entries.what: Takes dinner at home while Isabel mentions Dulce-style friend drama from school; Ramón is off, and they watch a movie.
entries.outcome: Relaxed family evening.

entries.what: Does the Saturday morning shop at Ruiz Family Market and stops at Panadería Las Hermanas for rolls and conchas despite the heat.
entries.outcome: Stocked the kitchen.

entries.what: Waters calamansi and tomato pots in the backyard early to protect them from the heat wave.
entries.outcome: Plants survived the day.

entries.what: Helps Corazón with her pills and keeps her inside during the hottest hours.
entries.outcome: Nanay stayed cool and comfortable.

entries.what: Takes Corazón to Tagalog Mass at 9 at Our Lady of the Marsh, then lunch at home with the family.
entries.outcome: Mass and lunch as usual.

entries.what: Grades at the kitchen table and asks the assistant for a lab procedure; when it explains why the procedure works first, she says just the steps please.
entries.outcome: Gets a clean numbered procedure for next week's lab.

entries.what: Sets up her week, glances at unit dates for the Unit 1 schedule, and notes the mid-November conference dates.
entries.outcome: Calendar ready for the week.

new_facts.value: turned in the first absence form on time Aug 29
